body.p: with the best for the service you have done me Do come to me and don’t sever my brotherly ties;

p.n: If One Gives Up a Friend One Loses Out

body.p:
for he who takes a friend,
and cuts off any brotherly connections and loses his friendship, will be prevented from reaping the fruits of his brotherhood;

and know that what I owe you will be
bestowed upon you.’”

p.n: The Rat Distinguishes Hidden from Overt Enmity

body.p:
“The rat cried back ‘Many an open friendship is deep down a hidden enmity, which is
more harmful than open enmity,

and its outcome is similar to that of a man who rides the tusk of a rutting elephant
then falls asleep, topples over, and perishes.

p.n: An Enemy Is Befriended in Times of Need

body.p:
Now the friend is called a friend precisely for the benefits one hopes
to gain from him, and the enemy is called an enemy for the damage one fears from him; so when the sensible man hopes
to benefit from the enemy, he shows him friendship. Don’t
